omitted.full_factorial: not run; one-factor-at-a-time around the reference plus the listed crossings
omitted.n=10000: only at the reference condition (4,000 steps); no factor sweeps at 10,000
omitted.n=100000: reference condition only, at 400 steps (9 variants) and 4,000 steps (variants A, C, E, F, H); no 40,000-step run
omitted.horizon=40000: reference condition only, n = 1,500, variants A, C, D, E, F, G, H
omitted.variant J: run only where records can behave differently (record dynamics, collapse regimes, reference)
omitted.variant B: vocabulary control run in the reference and in 8 structural conditions
omitted.graph sizes 512 / 2048: variants A, C, E, F, H only (compiling 512–2048 bindings per check makes the other variants ~2 h each)
